title: Cobblemon: Gholdengo Colorful Cosmetics
description: Adds new cosmetic forms to Gholdengo giving you a range of new coloured stripes on your Golden Wonder.
body:
# Gholdengo Cosmetic Trims

Give Gholdengo a fresh new look with a collection of cosmetic appearances inspired by Cobblemon’s Type Gems and Tumblestones.

This pack adds **21 cosmetic variant**s for Gholdengo, allowing you to customise its colours while keeping its stats, moves and gameplay completely unchanged. Each design has been carefully recoloured to match the item it represents while still retaining Gholdengo’s original style.
